paragraphs: Rav Yeimar bar Shelemya spoke to Abaye: Chullin 107b. In Abaye’s name: Shabbat 66b, 156a; Moed Katan 6b; Sukkah 7b; Sotah 22a: be-Rabbi Shelemya. He spoke to Mar Zutra: Berakhot 53b, end. He sent to Rav Pappa: Menachot 31a. He objected to Rava: Bava Batra 9a. In Rav’s name—it should read Rava—end of Bammeh Ishah.
